name: Imagic BB Cream SPF 30PA++ 15gm
description:
Imagic BB Cream SPF 30PA++ 15gm 
Natural Nude BB Cream 
SPF30+ Sun Protection & Isolation 
Silky Smooth & Flawless 
Hydrating & Non-Drying. 
SPF30+ sunscreen isolation, silky smooth and flawless, natural and not fake. 
Light and thin skin, hydrating and brightening, not easy to pull dry; natural ingredients: Glycerin: hydrating skin, hold makeup effect; 
oatmeal extract: nourish the skin, reduce wrinkles and anti-aging; golden chamomile extract: effective inhibition of allergies, lock color antioxidant; Centella Asiatica Extract: repair skin.
